hypothesis: Running best-of-N sampling on the champion adapter, then deterministically fixing 3rd-to-2nd person phrasing defects, should push quality above the current plateau — because the adapter already has strong judgment, and surface phrasing errors are the remaining correctable gap.
technique: Multiple greedy/sampled drafts from the champion LoRA adapter (best-of-N ensemble), followed by a deterministic Swift select stage that filters on compound/filler defects, then a deterministic post-processing pass that repairs 3rd-to-2nd person phrasing. A greedy single-draft floor is also applied to anchor the selection.
result: Scored 0.377 on the full-30 gate (1 win / 3 ties / 25 losses vs Sonnet), with specPass=100% and rubric scores atom=5, spec=3, cover=3, nat=4, nonRed=4. Despite perfect spec compliance and strong atomicity/naturalness, coverage remained at 3 and overall quality fell short — the hypothesis was not confirmed and the run was discarded.
